text:
sanjay: Quick triage — seeing host CPU spike on ingress path during peak load, looks like tokenization + request parse syscall storm. attaching microprofile results shortly
ciara: Yup, noticed elevated syscalls on canary. gRPC path shows tons of small write() / sendmsg() calls. :grimacing:
oliver: Can you paste the perf or strace snippet? wondering if writev coalescing at proxy would help
sanjay: paste from strace sample:
```
write(3, "", 16) = 16
write(3, "", 16) = 16
write(3, "", 12) = 12
...  // hundreds per request
```
maya: Two quick things: tokenization is doing per-request allocations and copying into a temp buffer, and parser runs a full JSON parse for each small metadata header. both are expensive
ciara: On the grpc side, grpc-js layer does flush per chunk; we saw 128B chunks frequently. Maybe HTTP/2 SETTINGS or window management causing small segments
oliver: Proposed short fixes: 1) coalesce writes in host proxy for up to 2ms or 8KB; 2) add a tiny tokenization pool with reuse + pre-reserved buffer to avoid realloc; 3) short-circuit parse for our small metadata envelope (fast-path).
maya: I have a WIP branch that vectorizes tokenizer and reuses Vec backing buffer, reduces copies. bench locally: p95 tokenization 12ms -> 3.5ms for a 4k prompt.
sanjay: Ran an ingress microbench with 2000 reqs/s, before vs after coalesce + pool:
```
Before: host CPU 78% avg, p95 latency 118ms, syscalls/sec ~ 42k
After: host CPU 42% avg, p95 latency 84ms, syscalls/sec ~ 11k
```
ciara: That's promising. Any regression risk for streaming granularity? some apps expect small flushes for interactive UX
oliver: We'll make coalesce window config-driven and model-aware. default conservative (2ms), route-level override for interactive routes.
maya: Also KV cache: saw thrash when many small requests miss fast prefix hit — serialization per request causes alloc pressure. Suggest keeping small per-connection prefix cache and reusing serialization buffers.
perf-bot: benchmark-run #2467890 finished: net improvement 27% cost-per-token on host path for the tested payloads
build-bot: canary deploy queued: eng-runtime/token-pool-coalesce v3 -> canary cluster at 2467890400
sanjay: Action items: @maya finish tokenizer pool PR + perf numbers (due EOD), @oliver add writev coalesce config + tests, @ciara run interactive user-flow smoke with different windows. I'll coordinate rollback hooks.
ciara: I'll run smoke with 0.5ms/2ms/5ms windows and post traces.
maya: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eng-runtime/pull/471 — includes bench scripts and trace artifacts
oliver: Nice. If canary is stable for 2 hours we'll promote. thx all :thumbsup:
sanjay: Great work — keep notes in the perf doc and I'll follow up with a short postmortem if anything regresses.
